items.title: Q-040c dACC PE-weight delta correlation, config fix + pre-flight smoke gate (supersedes V3-EXQ-475b)
items.note: Successor to V3-EXQ-475b in the goal_pipeline:GAP-4 Tier-1 cohort. 475b FAILed at precondition P2 (dACC engagement): 0/6 seed-x-arm cells showed any dACC firing (n_dacc_fires=0 throughout, confirmed via REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-475b_2026-08-01.md). Root cause code-traced: ree_core/agent.py gates dACC's forward pass on `self.dacc is not None and z_harm_a is not None`; z_harm_a stayed structurally None because 475b's _build_arm_config called _lib.goal_pipeline_tier1.build_config(env, gap4_arm) WITHOUT enable_affective_harm_stream=True (default False; that flag is what wires use_harm_stream/use_affective_harm_stream/z_harm_a_dim into the config on the gap4_operating branch) -- the exact V3-EXQ-620/625 measurement-artifact footgun build_config's own docstring names by precedent. FIX (only substantive change from 475b): _build_arm_config now passes enable_affective_harm_stream=True; run_seed_arm also now stamps env._exq_env_kwargs explicitly (was previously coincidental via the module default) since that flag's branch reads limb_damage_enabled off it. Everything else -- P1 MECH-269b V_s-gating precondition, the Spearman-rho(|PE|, dACC bias-magnitude) correlation statistic, seeds 42/7/19, the 2-arm ARM_vs_off/ARM_vs_on structure, acceptance thresholds -- is unchanged. NEW: pre-flight smoke gate (autopsy learning #3) -- _preflight_dacc_engagement_check() runs a cheap pilot rollout (ARM_vs_on, seed 42, 3 warmup + 1 eval episode x 20 steps) BEFORE the full 3-seed x 2-arm design and raises PreflightDaccNotFiring (uncaught, fail-fast ERROR) if n_dacc_fires==0, so a structurally-dead dACC is caught in seconds rather than after the full ~90min budget. Verified both directions this session: with the fix, preflight measured n_dacc_fires=20/20 pilot steps and the full --dry-run's two cells measured n_dacc_fires=[48,48] (nonzero, confirms engagement); a monkeypatched negative control (forcing enable_affective_harm_stream=False, i.e. reproducing 475b's exact bug) correctly raised PreflightDaccNotFiring with n_dacc_fires=0. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is the dACC bias-magnitude vs precision-weighted-PE correlation WITH dACC actually engaging. `reanalysis_query.py query --readout rho_pe_vs_bias_magnitude --claim Q-040` returns exactly one manifest (475b's own), whose n_dacc_fires=0 in every cell -- nothing to reanalyze. Not recoverable -> proceed to author. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): 0 prior substrate_ceiling autopsies tag claim_ids=["Q-040"] (checked via the skill's standard grep-count method over REE_assembly/evidence/planning/failure_autopsy_*.json) -- does not fire. 475b's own autopsy is a non_contributory driver-bug category (measurement/instrumentation), not substrate_ceiling, and is correctly excluded by that method. conditions=2 here (not 475b's original queue entry's conditions=6, which did not match its own seeds=3 x verdict-line count -- 475b's script never actually printed a verdict line at all, a latent progress-instrumentation gap; this version adds one verdict: PASS/FAIL print per seed-x-arm cell, so seeds(3) x conditions(2) = 6 total cells = 6 verdict lines, consistent). validate_experiments.py --strict --paths experiments/v3_exq_862_q040c_dacc_pe_weight_delta_correlation.py: OK, 0 findings across all 19 checks. --dry-run: both cells complete, verdict PASS x2, correctly self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue at the 1-seed smoke scale (P1/P2 both require >=2/3 seeds, matching 475b's own smoke-scale behaviour) -- expected, not a defect.

items.title: MECH-321 harm-aware selection: does SD-hazard-aware-policy-decomposition improve V3-EXQ-844's task-outcome statistic, at matched abort rates?
items.note: EVIDENCE successor to V3-EXQ-844 (confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-844_2026-08-01.md), which found MECH-321's mid-execution abort mechanism engages correctly (C2 mechanistic corroboration PASSED, +0.000247 forward-PE reduction) but does NOT reduce task harm (C1 load-bearing FAILED, -0.003262, wrong direction) using a paired post-divergence-window fresh-selection-restricted statistic. Code-verified root cause: the redecomposition step read no harm-valence signal and performed no ranked selection among candidate re-tilings at all. SD-hazard-aware-policy-decomposition (implemented 2026-08-01, ree-v3 a4a1b1d, chip-20260801-hazard-aware-decomp-build) closes that gap: PolicyDecomposition.harm_bias() (Stage 1, graded, always-active additive score_bias term) + .select_harm_aware_leaves() (Stage 2, categorical, threshold-gated pool-admission override), both default-OFF/bit-identical no-ops, gated by decomposition_use_harm_aware_selection (verified present on origin/main via git show origin/main:ree_core/agent.py). This run tests the exact follow-on named by both claims.yaml (MECH-321, 2026-08-01 entry) and the SD doc: does harm-aware selection improve V3-EXQ-844's C1 task-outcome statistic, ON vs OFF, at matched abort rates? ARM_SELECTION_OFF/ARM_SELECTION_ON hold 844's own manipulation (use_persistent_committed_program_handle, i.e. abort mechanism) FIXED ON in BOTH arms -- this is NOT a re-test of 844's own axis or of the refused 816e pre-commit/R1 env-harshening re-pose (re-derive brake check, Step 2.5b: 0 substrate_ceiling/non_contributory autopsy hits against MECH-321 at this granularity) -- and add decomposition_use_harm_aware_selection as the ONLY new manipulated variable, at the SD doc's / PolicyDecompositionConfig dataclass's / REEConfig.from_dims's default parameter values (verified identical across all three by direct source read; no documented reason to deviate). C1 STATISTIC REUSED VERBATIM from V3-EXQ-844 (_windowed_delta / _first_divergence_tick / _mean_at / fresh-selection-restricted split / EFFECT_SIZE_K_SIGMA=1.0 / REL_IMPROVEMENT_FLOOR=0.0 / MIN_DECOMPOSING_SEEDS=2), applied to ARM_SELECTION_OFF vs ARM_SELECTION_ON. MATCHED ABORT RATES (required design element, handled two ways): (a) per-seed decomp_n_decomposed_midexec counts and their ON-minus-OFF delta are recorded for every seed as a non-gating covariate (abort_rate_covariate); (b) the load-bearing C1 windowed comparison is restricted to seeds where BOTH arms independently decomposed mid-execution this run (both_decompose_seeds), so the measured delta reflects selection QUALITY among candidates the abort already produced, not whether an abort happened at all -- seeds where only one arm decomposed (on_only/off_only, an abort-rate-shift signature) are reported separately in unmatched_windowed_deltas, non-gating. New readiness precondition harm_bias_engages (ON arm only, existential: decomp_n_harm_bias_nonzero > 0) self-routes substrate_not_ready_requeue rather than a C1 verdict if the treatment channel never engaged (z_harm_a never rose above harm_threat_floor this run). GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout (paired matched-abort-pair windowed harm delta between harm-aware-selection ON/OFF) does not exist in any prior manifest -- confirmed via reanalysis_query.py query --readout decomposition_harm_bias --claim MECH-321 (0 of 4 matched manifests carry it, substrate built 2026-08-01) -- not recoverable, proceed to author. ARM_SELECTION_OFF cells ARE recoverable via arm-reuse from V3-EXQ-844's own reuse-eligible ARM_HANDLE_ON mint (verified: 844 manifest's ARM_HANDLE_ON rows carry arm_fingerprint.reuse_eligible=True, include_driver_script_in_hash=False, needed_keys all present) -- try_reuse_cell attempted per seed citing 844's run_id; a HIT (likely on a matching cloud machine-class) skips re-running that cell entirely, a REFUSE (e.g. machine-class mismatch) falls through to a fresh run, itself re-minted reuse-eligible. This means ARM_SELECTION_OFF's actual verdict-line count on the real run may be below its nominal 6 (reused cells print no verdict line) -- expected, not a bug; ARM_SELECTION_ON always runs fresh (6 verdict lines). estimated_minutes is calibrated against 844's OWN measured elapsed_seconds=22213.6 (~370 min, all 12 cells run fresh there) rather than 844's own originally-declared (and substantially wrong) 35-minute estimate, since this run's worst case (all reuse refused) is compute-equivalent to 844's. claim_ids=["MECH-321"] (matches 844's convention -- v3_pending stays true regardless of this run's outcome per the claims.yaml note; a single validation run does not clear the V3-pending gate on its own). bears_on = [MECH-321, SD-hazard-aware-policy-decomposition, ARC-070, ARC-071] (ARC-070 is MECH-321's parent claim; ARC-071 carried over from 844's own bears_on for chunk-composition symmetry). validate_experiments.py --strict --paths: OK, 0 findings (one config_slice-declaration advisory WARN resolved via CONFIG_SLICE_DECLARATION_EXEMPT -- the static resolver cannot trace the arm_id-conditional _config_slice() dispatch to the ON-arm branch; the harm-aware-selection constants ARE declared, under their REEConfig-mirror key names). --dry-run smoke: all 12 cells (2 arms x 6 seeds, 2 episodes x 12 steps) complete cleanly, manifest written and correctly relocated out of evidence/experiments/ (dry_run relocation confirmed), no crash; readiness correctly self-routes ARM_SELECTION_ON red / manipulation_inert_or_unmatched at this toy scale (harm_bias_engages precondition unmet -- expected, z_harm_a does not clear harm_threat_floor in 2 episodes; this is the smoke test working as intended, not a design defect).

items.title: Q-086 gentler-env confound control REDESIGN (3 arms incl. new num_hazards=0 floor, 6 seeds, survival-time DV; successor to V3-EXQ-857)
items.note:
REDESIGN of V3-EXQ-857 (Q-086 gentler-env confound control), per its confirmed failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-857_2026-08-01.md (status: confirmed) routing: "/queue-experiment a redesign with more seeds (5-10), a starker environmental gradient (e.g. num_hazards 4 vs 0), and episode-survival-time as an explicit secondary DV." 857's own readiness precondition (gentle_env_manipulation_took_z_harm_s_differs, num_hazards 4 vs 1, n=3 seeds) FAILED: cross-arm z_harm_s SNR 0.42 vs required >=2.0 -- diagnosed as a POWER problem, not a wrong hypothesis. This entry implements all three routed fixes together: (a) doubles seeds to 6, (b) adds a starker num_hazards=0/hazard_food_attraction=0.0 ARM_BENIGN floor (reported alongside 857's original ARM_GENTLE=1/0.2 for cross-attempt comparability), (c) instruments mean/min episode_survival_steps per arm as a NEW non-gating secondary precondition, directly measuring the uncounted signal 857's autopsy flagged (min_eval_steps 58 harsh vs 125 gentle). The self-route keys off the STARKEST pair (harsh vs benign), not 857's original pair. claims.yaml Q-086 already cites this routing (2026-08-01T17:22Z governance cycle, REE_assembly 5c7e5e1134) and stays candidate pending this run. Not a literal 'supersedes' of V3-EXQ-857 per the EXQ versioning policy -- 857's own non_contributory verdict already excludes it from scoring, so there is nothing for this entry to invalidate; this extends the diagnostic chain rather than correcting a bug in 857.

GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4, re-verified 2026-08-01): decisive readout = cross-arm z_harm_s SNR at num_hazards 4-vs-0. `reanalysis_query.py query --readout z_harm_s --claim Q-086` returns exactly 1 manifest (V3-EXQ-857 itself, substrate_hash 690c1ccd29756988..., ARM_HARSH num_hazards=4 + ARM_GENTLE num_hazards=1 only) -- no num_hazards=0 arm exists in the corpus. Not recoverable -> a new ARM_BENIGN cell is required, proceeded to author.

Substrate readiness (Step 2.5, re-verified 2026-08-01): claims.yaml Q-086 is status=candidate, no v3_pending / implementation_phase:v3 gate. Reuses the affective_fishtank baseline lib verbatim (same SD-011/SD-019/MECH-219 harm-stream substrate as V3-EXQ-664/856/857, already IMPLEMENTED). num_hazards=0 verified against current ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py source: hazard placement is `for _ in range(min(self.num_hazards, len(forage_pool)))`, every subsequent hazard drift/move/food-attraction branch is gated on `if self.hazards:`, and background_drift_enabled defaults False and is not set by this baseline -- so num_hazards=0 gives a genuine hazard-free floor with no division-by-hazard-count or other edge case, not an untested config.

Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b, re-verified 2026-08-01): 1 counted substrate_ceiling-family autopsy on Q-086 (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-857_2026-08-01, category measurement_test_design_defect / non_contributory -- an INSTRUMENT/readiness defect owing no substrate build, not a substrate_ceiling verdict), well under threshold=2. Brake does not fire.

DV-SYMMETRY (Step 3.5): the manipulation (hazard count/food-attraction) changes the environment's actual harm dynamics; none of the CoV/level/survival-time DVs are invariant under any broadcast/rescale/permutation of it.

Code review (Step 3.5) / smoke test (Step 4): script is a near-verbatim extension of V3-EXQ-857 (same affective_fishtank baseline, same phased warmup+eval structure, same arm_cell/ZGoalStreamAccumulator/write_flat_manifest wiring, all re-verified against current ree-v3 source 2026-08-01) with a third arm, 6 seeds, and the new survival-time DV/precondition added. --dry-run smoke (3 arms x 6 seeds = 18 cells) ran to completion: correctly self-routed FAIL / substrate_not_ready_requeue (expected at toy dry-run scale -- 3 warmup / 2 eval episodes cannot move z_harm_s any more than a real run's precondition could be read from it), all 18 arm_fingerprints stamped, [smoke] z_goal_stream: active_frac=0.000 ticks=0/2295 writer_calls=2295 goal_state_present=True n_agents=18 -- no writer defect. items.title: ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-B (H2: F-dominance) -- f_weight attenuation ladder, committed-class entropy
items.note: ARC-062 GOV-FANOUT-1 Leg P-B (H2: F-dominance, downstream of selection). Design of record: REE_assembly/evidence/planning/arc_062_conversion_fanout_2026-07-29.md Section 2 Leg P-B + "P-B buildability resolution (2026-07-31)". claim_ids=[] (diagnostic; brake-exempt per fanout doc Section 4 -- P-B tests a different mechanism from Leg P-A, claim-neutral by design; not a re-derive-brake case).  (a) GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = paired-by-seed committed-class entropy across an f_weight attenuation ladder, under the lateral_pfc-routed + CRF-ON + MECH-448/449-active matched-stack config. f_weight did not exist before V3-EXQ-852 (SD-085 landed ree-v3 main 12374fb, 2026-07-31). V3-EXQ-852 itself (ree-v3 995c7db) tested f_weight only under substrate DEFAULTS, not this leg's CRF-ON matched stack; no other manifest sweeps f_weight at all. Not recoverable by reanalysis -> proceed to author.  (b) Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): claim_ids=[], brake-EXEMPT per fanout doc Section 4 ("P-B/P-C/P-D are brake-exempt... P-B tests a different mechanism").  (c) SD-085 landing: ree-v3 main 12374fb ("SD-085: E3Config.f_weight -- weight on F (reality cost) in score_trajectory"). REE_assembly/docs/architecture/ sd_085_e3_reality_cost_weight.md. E3Config.f_weight: float = 1.0 (no-op default), multiplicative coefficient on F in E3TrajectorySelector.score_trajectory (ree_core/predictors/e3_selector.py:1190). Set directly post-construction (agent.e3.config.f_weight = X), matching the lambda_ethical/rho_residue sweep idiom -- not wired through REEConfig.from_dims().  (d) CORRECTED route source: this leg's matched stack uses modulatory_channel_route_source="lateral_pfc" (V3-EXQ-851's corrected value, ree-v3 3c5d45a9dd + substrate branch in ree_core/agent.py), NOT the design doc's original literal "gated_policy" text, which V3-EXQ-851's own erratum (design doc, "Erratum (2026-07-31)" section) proved does not route the rule-apprehension/CRF channel at all.  (e) NEW C1(h) F_WEIGHT_KNOB_LIVE gate: on genuine fresh-select P2 ticks (same latch-clearing discipline as C1g), confirms mean_f_weighted falls within a +/-2% interval of f_weight * mean_f_raw (agent.e3._last_traj_components), on a majority of seeds, on EVERY rung -- i.e. the f_weight knob genuinely rescales F through the FULL matched-stack pipeline at every attenuation level, not just at substrate defaults (V3-EXQ-852's scope). C1(a-g) reused verbatim from V3-EXQ-851 (same names/thresholds) but re-scoped from "both arms" to "all four rungs" since CRF is now a matched constant ON everywhere (no OFF arm in this design); C1(d) is necessarily re-expressed as a direct magnitude floor (mean_lateral_pfc_bias_abs > PROP_NONVAC_FLOOR) rather than a paired ON/OFF diff. C1_holds requires all eight sub-gates to hold at majority-of-seeds on EVERY rung. Any C1 fail on any rung -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, never a verdict.  (f) DV-symmetry declaration (mandatory, 604c net): committed-class entropy is a function of the argmax action-class sequence. f_weight rescales ONE per-candidate-VARYING term (F -- not a broadcast scalar) relative to M/Phi in the score sum; neither a uniform additive shift (argmax-cancelling) nor a whole-score monotone rescale -- so it is NOT invariant under the committed-class DV's argmax symmetry and legitimately CAN change the committed argmin, at every rung.  (g) Declared-null three-branch map (NO weakens, claim_ids=[]): (1) any C1(a-h) fails on any rung -> substrate_not_ready_requeue, evidence_direction=unknown. (2) C1 holds on all 4 rungs AND C2 holds (F000-vs-F100 committed-class-entropy lift >= 0.05 nats on >=2/3 seeds) -> f_dominance_confirmed_h2_operative_ceiling, evidence_direction=non_contributory but a load-bearing GOVERNANCE ROUTING signal (ARC-062's behavioural retest should be gated behind an F-rebalance substrate landing). (3) C1 holds AND C2 fails -> f_dominance_refuted_as_sole_cause, evidence_direction=non_contributory; per the fanout doc's P-C resolution, H3 (competence/action-learning) is already "eliminated" in hypothesis_space_registry.v1.json -- this branch corroborates the already-tracked H-observation-interface root rather than reopening H3.  (h) Code review (Step 3.5): full checklist walked against the script -- claim tagging (claim_ids=[] correct for a claim-neutral diagnostic; EXPERIMENT_PURPOSE ="diagnostic" correct); diagnostic adjudication (9 preconditions C1a-h all readiness-kind with measured/threshold/met, load_bearing C2 criterion, criteria_non_degenerate for all 9); substrate API correctness (f_weight, _last_traj_components["f"]/["f_weighted"], and the "lateral_pfc" route branch independently grepped live in ree_core before writing); phased training (P0/P1/ P2 unchanged from 851); sample-size integrity (same latch-clearing idiom as 851/791a -- last_score_diagnostics cleared before every select_action, C1g and the new C1h reads both gated on the SAME fresh-select check since _last_traj_components is populated in the same score_trajectory call); progress instrumentation ([train] ep N/M with M=total_train_eps loop bound, verdict PASS/FAIL per seed*rung = 12 lines, Seed/Condition boundary lines); output contract (run_id _v3, architecture_epoch, outcome exact field, stamp_recording_core via write_flat_manifest, z_goal_stream wired via ZGoalStreamAccumulator per 852's pattern -- an improvement over 851, which leaves it NOT RECORDED); runner conformance (emit_outcome at end of __main__, dry_run threaded through). One finding during review: validate_experiments.py flagged a new anchor-reachability WARN not present on 851 (851 is experiment_purpose="evidence", which the lint skips entirely; this script is correctly "diagnostic" per the locked design, so the identically-shaped C1a-g/h preconditions newly trip it). Resolved with a documented ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT (the preconditions are live-measurement COUNT aggregates, not known-degenerate-reference anchors -- there is no predicate-vs-frozen-reference mismatch to guard against, matching the precedent set by V3-EXQ-852's own exemption reasoning for its one by-construction precondition).  (i) Smoke test (--dry-run): all 4 rungs x 1 seed complete cleanly, verdict PASS x4, manifest written+cleaned. C1/C1h correctly read False on the tiny dry-run dose (2 P2 episodes x 30 steps cannot clear the readiness floors -- expected, matches 851's own dry-run behaviour). Independently verified the C1(h) F_WEIGHT_KNOB_LIVE logic via a direct run_experiment() call: at every rung mean_f_weighted matched f_weight*mean_f_raw within the 2% interval exactly as designed (e.g. ARM_F000 f_weight=0.0 -> mean_f_weighted=0.0 bit-exact; ARM_F100 f_weight=1.0 -> mean_f_weighted==mean_f_raw exactly), confirming the knob-live check computation is correct before the real run. [smoke] z_goal_stream: active_frac=0.000 ticks=0/455 writer_calls=455 goal_state_present=True n_agents=4 -- no writer defect (correctly wired, zero active_frac expected on the tiny dry-run dose).  (j) validate_experiments.py --strict: 0 findings across all 19 checks (0 anchor-reachability-warnings after the ANCHOR_REACHABILITY_EXEMPT addition; 0 arm-fingerprint-backlog; 0 stale-e3-diagnostics; 0 precondition-recomputability; 0 dead-z_goal-stream; matches V3-EXQ-851's own fully-clean state).  Reuses V3-EXQ-851's matched-stack + C1(a-g) + latch-clearing machinery verbatim per the fanout doc's own instruction ("Leg P-B... hold the rule-apprehension channel ON and lateral_pfc-routed... as a matched constant"). One deliberate deviation from 851: the within-class-representative-entropy SECONDARY negative control is dropped -- its framing ("rule bias is class-keyed, cannot move within-class selection") is specific to sweeping use_candidate_rule_field, which is now a matched constant here, not the swept variable; nothing in this leg's design spec depends on it.

items.title: MECH-166 wall-independent representation confirmer (slot_cosine_sim sole gate, ARC-065 noise-floor diversity fix)
items.note: IGW-20260801-223 (claim MECH-166, backlog EVB-0475, "Proposal for MECH-166") + IGW-20260801-225 (GOV-CONFIRM-1, "Confirm evidence: MECH-166, lit 0.88 exp ~0"). Prior draft (session 6ac06193-...-worktrees-best-practices-3e2efc, RELATIONSHIP.md + DESIGN.md) found these are the SAME evidence gap for MECH-166 (genuine_exp_count: 0 despite literature_confidence 0.876) -- one redesigned experiment discharges both, not two. Supersedes V3-EXQ-436 -> V3-EXQ-436a (both non_contributory, FAIL, conjunctive C1-AND-C2 gate). 436a's own evidence_direction_note diagnosed the root cause as a monomodal (bit-identical) waking policy starving the SWS-analog consolidation pass, and named the exact requeue condition: land ARC-065's behavioural-diversity substrate, then requeue as V3-EXQ-436b. ARC-065 is status:stable, v3_pending:False as of 2026-07-11 (claims.yaml, re-confirmed live 2026-08-01). (a) GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = slot_cosine_sim differentiation (SWS_THEN_REM vs WAKING_ONLY). reanalysis_query.py --readout slot_cosine_sim --claim MECH-166 found exactly one prior manifest (436a itself), flagged UNVERIFIABLE (no substrate_hash -- pre-recording-standard). Not recoverable by reanalysis -> proceed to author. (b) Substrate readiness (Step 2.5): ARC-065 (noise_floor.py, MECH-313) confirmed BUILT live at ree_core/policy/noise_floor.py + ree_core/utils/config.py:3238 (use_noise_floor default False, threaded via REEConfig.from_dims). MECH-313 itself is claim-status candidate/v3_pending:True but is a substrate DEPENDENCY here, not the claim under test (substrate built, evidence separate pattern) -- not a blocker. (c) Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): MECH-166 0 braking autopsies, ARC-045 0, SD-017 1 -- all below the >=2 threshold. Brake does not fire. (d) LOAD-BEARING FIX FOUND DURING RE-VERIFICATION (this is what the draft flagged as an unconfirmed open item, and it was real): noise_floor.py's own docstring states its integration site is REEAgent.select_action() -> e3.select(temperature=effective_T) (confirmed live, agent.py:7438-7444). 436a's action-selection helpers (_select_action_baseline/_select_action_context_cond) never called select_action() -- they looped over discrete actions via agent.e2.world_forward + agent.e3.harm_eval and took a deterministic argmin. Simply setting use_noise_floor=True on the config while keeping that argmin path would have had ZERO effect on trajectory diversity (noise_floor constructed but never consulted), silently reproducing 436a's exact failure. FIXED: both action-selection functions now sample via softmax(-harms/effective_T) + torch.multinomial, using agent.noise_floor.compute_effective_temperature(...) -- the same computation the substrate's own select_action() performs, applied to this driver's own harm-based candidate scores. Verified in the --dry-run smoke: per-episode action-class entropy ~1.53 nats (close to ln(5)=1.609 uniform-over-5-actions), confirming genuine stochastic diversity is now live (vs the ~0 entropy the deterministic argmin would give). A defensive `assert agent.noise_floor is not None` guards against a future wiring regression. (e) DV primacy inverted per IGW-225's explicit mandate: slot_cosine_sim is now the SOLE PASS/FAIL gate (C1: slot_cosine_sim(SWS_THEN_REM) < slot_cosine_sim(WAKING_ONLY) in >=3/5 seeds -- directional per ARC-045's own pre-registered claims.yaml experimental implication, not the 436a bidirectional-diff shape, since ARC-045/SD-017/MECH-166 predict a specific sign). Behavioural metrics (harm_rate_*) and slot_separation (C4, ARC-045 secondary) are recorded but never gate. All three claim_ids share this one wall-independent test since claims.yaml's own notes for SD-017 and ARC-045 independently specify the identical cosine_sim comparison as their experimental implication. (f) DV-symmetry declaration (604c net, mandatory): the manipulation (ran SWS+REM consolidation vs not) directly mutates agent.e1.context_memory.memory via ContextMemory.write() during sleep, and slot_cosine_sim reads that same tensor -- not a broadcast constant, monotone rescale, or permutation, so the DV is not invariant under any of the flagged symmetry classes. (g) Scope: 436a's 3rd arm (SWS_ONLY) dropped -- not required for the primary MECH-166 question; the freed budget stays on the 2-condition (WAKING_ONLY, SWS_THEN_REM) x 5-seed comparison. items.title: MECH-135 discriminative pair (E1_COE vs FROZEN z_world), StepHarness-invariant re-run of V3-EXQ-108
items.note: StepHarness-invariant re-run of V3-EXQ-108 (MECH-135 discriminative pair: does letting z_world co-evolve (E1_COE) during trajectory-scoring rollouts, vs freezing it (FROZEN), improve real-environment plan selection). Motivated by claims.yaml MECH-135's evidence_quality_note (tag multi_sense_audit_2026_05_08), which flags that V3-EXQ-108's _train_agent() called agent.sense() TWICE per env step (latent_prev before the action, latent_next after), doubling the substrate-tick rate during training vs eval's single-sense cadence -- exactly the failure mode experiments/_harness.py's StepHarness class exists to make structurally impossible (its own docstring names it verbatim). GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout = real-env prox_delta (E1_COE vs FROZEN) from a StepHarness-invariant (single-sense-per-step) trained agent. Checked experiment_queue.json, runner_status.json, ree-v3/experiments/ directory listing, git log -S '108a' / 'stepharness' -- no prior 108-family StepHarness port or re-run exists anywhere. Not recoverable -> proceed to author. Re-derive brake (Step 2.5b): no failure_autopsy artifact tags MECH-135 (0 count) -- brake does not apply. PORTING APPROACH (see script module docstring for full rationale): only Phase 0 (_train_agent) carried the confound; Phases 1-6 (goal template, warmup state, candidate generation, FROZEN/E1_COE scoring, real-env execution) already sense() once per step and are byte-identical to V3-EXQ-108, since they replay externally-specified action sequences StepHarness's own on-policy select_action cannot reproduce. _train_agent is restructured to call sense() exactly once per step, pairing (latent,action) from step N with step N+1's sense() result to form the (s_t,a_t,s_t+1) triple the bespoke E1/E2 single-step MSE losses need (the same one-step-behind accumulation StepHarness's own module docstring recommends for warmup-with-aux-losses callers). The literal StepHarness class is deliberately NOT instantiated for training: its internal _e1_tick (multi-rate-scheduled inside generate_trajectories) calls agent.e1's forward pass and mutates agent.e1._hidden_state (confirmed stateful LSTM, ree_core/predictors/e1_deep.py), which would contend with this script's own per-step direct agent.e1(...) calls -- reintroducing an uncontrolled multi-rate substrate-advancement hazard (the same failure class, just relocated from sense() to E1's hidden state) unless the losses were also switched to agent.compute_prediction_loss()'s save/restore pattern (a materially different multi-step-window loss formulation used by V3-EXQ-514g, which would change more than the audited confound). 108's bespoke losses and its original uniform-random training-exploration policy are otherwise UNCHANGED, so this stays a narrow bug-fix-tier iteration per CLAUDE.md's EXQ Versioning policy (letter suffix, not a new EXQ number) -- precedented by V3-EXQ-514d->514g's own StepHarness port under the same convention. PRODUCTION SCALE (seeds [42,123], 100 train episodes, 200 steps/ep, 40 candidate sequences, horizon 30, warmup 20, goal_max_steps 2000, c1_threshold=0.05, c3_var_threshold=0.002 -- the script's own non-smoke defaults), not smoke-test scale. SEPARATE FINDING surfaced while re-reading 108's evidence (recorded here for the audit trail; NOT fixed by this entry -- claims.yaml is governance-only-edit territory): claims.yaml's MECH-135 note counts 108's 12:50:04Z run as a 'PASS ... second support entry', but that run is verifiably a --smoke-test run (n_train_episodes=2, thresholds relaxed to c1=-99.0/c3=0.0 -- matches the smoke-test override branch exactly), i.e. a vacuous test-mode pass, not real evidence. Meanwhile 108's SAME-DAY full-production-scale run (19:53:41Z, 100 episodes/200 steps/40 sequences/horizon 30/seeds [42,123], real thresholds) actually FAILED (c1_val=0.00229 << 0.05; c3 variance ~1.4e-14 << 0.002) -- but claims.yaml describes this run as having 'empty metrics -- runner artifact' and dismisses it, which does not match the manifest's actual (complete, non-empty) content. Flagged for governance review, not corrected here. Code review (Step 3.5): validate_experiments.py --strict clean (0 findings) after adding a check_degeneracy self-report (e1coe_score_var, prox_delta across seeds) and an AGENT_SEED_ORDER_EXEMPT citing V3-EXQ-108's own prior triage (agent_seed_order_lint_backlog_triage.md row 9 -- FROZEN/E1_COE scored off the literal same agent object within a seed, so unseeded weight init cannot confound the within-seed arm comparison). claim_ids=['MECH-135'] verified accurate (same mechanism under test as V3-EXQ-108). experiment_purpose='evidence'. Output contract (run_id _v3 suffix, architecture_epoch, outcome field, write_flat_manifest stamping recording-standard core) verified via dry-run manifest inspection. Smoke test (--dry-run): PASS, single seed, completes all 6 phases cleanly in ~1.6s, manifest correctly relocated out of evidence/experiments/ to the dry-run scratch dir (verified via find), sentinel written. [smoke] z_goal_stream: NOT RECORDED -- expected and unchanged from V3-EXQ-108: this script manually injects z_goal via direct GoalState._z_goal assignment (Phase 1) rather than the normal agent.update_z_goal() writer path, symmetrically across both arms, exactly as V3-EXQ-108 did -- not a new hazard introduced by this port.

items.title: ARC-062/MECH-309 full-budget replication of V3-EXQ-859: lateral_pfc route_source vs none ablation, MECH-448/449 engagement (~7.7h)
items.note: ARC-062/MECH-309 FULL-TRAINING-BUDGET replication of V3-EXQ-859's lateral_pfc-vs-none route_source ablation (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-859_2026-08-01.md, user-confirmed routing: "chip the full-training-budget (~7.7h) replication now ... rather than deferring the compute-cost judgment call to /governance"). BACKGROUND: V3-EXQ-851 (full ~7.7h, P0=200/P1=90/P2=60, seeds 42/43/44) found MECH-448 (F-eligibility demotion) completely dead (0.0) under modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc', vs robustly live (17.76) under 'cand_world_summary' in matched-stack template V3-EXQ-654j (same seeds). V3-EXQ-859 (cheap ~45min diagnostic, P0=10/P2=10, no P1) compared 'lateral_pfc' vs 'none' at the same seeds to isolate whether route_source itself is causal: MECH-448 was ALIVE in BOTH arms (3/3 seeds each) -- did NOT reproduce 851's collapse under either value. MECH-449 was dead in BOTH arms, matching its deadness in 851. Two readings remained undistinguished: (a) route_source has no causal effect on MECH-448 at all -- 851's diagnosis needs a different explanation; or (b) route_source's effect is training-duration-dependent and only emerges over a longer run, which 859's 45-minute probe cannot detect by construction. THIS RUN: same 2-arm ablation (modulatory_channel_route_source='lateral_pfc' vs 'none'), same seeds (42/43/44), same matched-stack config as V3-EXQ-859 (use_candidate_rule_field=True fixed on both arms, USE_F_ELIGIBILITY_DEMOTION/USE_GO_NOGO_CONSTITUTION/USE_DACC/USE_MODULATORY_SELECTION_AUTHORITY/USE_MODULATORY_CHANNEL_ROUTING all matched, identical ENV_KWARGS, identical CRF maturity levers, identical SD-056 online e2 training) but extended to FULL budget matching V3-EXQ-851's own schedule exactly: P0=200/P1=90/P2=60 (350 episodes/cell x 200 steps x 3 seeds x 2 arms = 420000 ticks, ~7.67h on the cloud fleet per 851's own measured elapsed_seconds=27623). P1 (bias-head REINFORCE training) is reused verbatim from V3-EXQ-851's own machinery -- 859 skipped P1 as out-of-scope for its structural-engagement question, but running it here reproduces 851's training schedule structurally, not just numerically, and does not privilege either arm since agent.lateral_pfc exists and trains on BOTH arms regardless of route_source. Primary readout is UNCHANGED from V3-EXQ-859 (NOT a rebuild of V3-EXQ-851's full C1(a-g) readiness gate + C2 committed-class-entropy falsifier apparatus): MECH-448 (f_eligibility_demotion_active_frac + mean f_eligibility_excluded_count) and MECH-449 (go_nogo_active_frac + mean safety+soft suppressions) engagement, latch-cleared on every P2 tick. claim_ids=[] (matches V3-EXQ-859's own convention -- routing diagnostic, not new MECH-309/ARC-062 evidence); experiment_purpose='diagnostic'; supersedes=null (does NOT supersede V3-EXQ-859 -- 859's short-budget result stands on its own terms as a correctly-self-routed 'needs_full_replication' finding, this is a duration-extended follow-up, not a bug-fix correction).
